title: Derived pullback along an isomorphism of schemes is an equivalence of ambient derived categories
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$,
uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\geq1$, and put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be an isomorphism of
schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let
$D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ be the derived categories of
sheaves of $A$-modules on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].
Then the derived pullback
$Lg^*=L(g_n)^*:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$
[def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] is an equivalence of categories: it is fully
faithful and essentially surjective. (A quasi-inverse is the functor induced by the
direct image $g_*$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] applied termwise, which is
$L(g^{-1})^*$.)
